description: gen schema --handler admits a built-in context handler a schema names: the committed processing/bind/handler-effect schema, read by suite path, names copy-fields in its context control's following effects. Without the flag generation fails closed with KDLITH-DLC006 and writes nothing; gen schema --help lists the flag; with --handler copy-fields the schema generates twice into two scratch trees the harness requires byte-identical, both runs the harness's generate step with the flag carried through its declarative args field. The generated crate compiles inside a scratch workspace materialized from this scenario's committed template. The compiled consumer supplies the handler's implementation itself: loading without admitting the name is rejected with KDLITH-DLC006, loading with the name admitted through the installed handlers succeeds, and the generated typed reader with those handlers installed reads the committed data document's stamp record with at=sv-se, the locale the handler copied into context, as vet data --handler copy-fields binds it

command: "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" gen schema "$KDLITH_FX_SUITE/processing/bind/handler-effect/schema.kdl" --crate stamp-proc --out refused; echo "exit=$?"; test -e refused || echo "refused absent"
stderr-contains: error[KDLITH-DLC006]: handler copy-fields is not installed

stdout-contains:
load without handler rejected codes=KDLITH-DLC006
schema ok
read errors=false lines=1
stamp at=sv-se
